rationale: The plan matches the reference on the core path: normalize (DESeq2 size factors + VST or log2-CPM) before rank-based per-sample scoring with GSVA/ssGSEA over the named, versioned Hallmark GMT with per-set overlap reported, then a per-signature two-group test with BH across the 50 sets, effect sizes, a condition-annotated heatmap, and a documented keep-and-sensitivity policy for sample_01. It omits any low-count gene filter entirely, and its QC is limited to library sizes with no PCA or sample-distance inspection of sample_01 or the score matrix. The contrast direction (inflamed minus control) and the row-scaling of the heatmap are not stated, and package versions are not requested in the report.
